spiritgiven.comments: Great spirit and communication! Was receptive to calls on both sides and great game overall
Calls were settled fast and players were receptive to opinions from sidelines!
Great sidelines and cheering. Comms was great too!

Overall, it was a very competitive and intense game. 

On communication, there were some difficulty on translation but we felt that calls should be settled by the players themselves and not by others around the field. 

Also, we felt that reactions can sometimes be incredulous and can be more receptive on both perspectives.

The captains talked about the level of contact before the game but we still felt that there was still significant level of contact before, during and after the play. 

On communication, we felt that players can be calmer and more receptive to calls from both perspective.

spiritreceived.comments:
チームを鼓舞する声がすごく良かった。
走るコースを体をぶつけて止める場面がたまに見られたのは修正してほしい。
A nice game, a bit physical from both teams but good attitude and communication from you guys throughout the game

There were instances that hands to our body were used to stop when our cutters try to move and get open, and some marking infractions throughout the game. Spirit Captain and sideline communicated well on adjustments made and apologized right after the game.
Contact on the mark could be a bit, also several fast counts.  Overall great spirited game, another fun match up, great job!

Thanks for a very close hard game to finish. We were very happy with your communication and your positive attitude throughout the game. It was a pleasure to play. There were a couple of instances where the rules were applied incorrectly including an offside call. However the game was very good and very enjoyable and was well spirited. Thank you!
